transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with the weekly power-support meeting. We've got four portable power units — P-1, P-2, P-3, and P-4 — all listed as serviceable and available. They need to cover the clinic, communications shelter, battery shop, and refrigerated storage area for the coming week. I'd like each of you to brief your area's needs so we can finalize the allocation and I can sign the support plan. Let's start with the power representative.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Ma'am, during yesterday's electrical inspection I confirmed that P-2 is the only unit with the recently certified isolated-output transformer required by the clinic's sensitive diagnostic equipment. The certification entry is still pending on the base inventory board, so it hasn't shown up there yet, but I personally verified it. That means P-2 needs to go to the clinic.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical compatibility requirement for the communications shelter. This morning I confirmed that the comm shelter's equipment requires regulated 28-volt output, which only P-4 provides. The updated compatibility note hasn't been added to the signal support annex yet, but I personally verified the requirement. That means P-4 needs to go to the communications shelter.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Ma'am, I need to flag a critical requirement for the battery shop. I confirmed with the battery-shop supervisor that the shop's charging rack requires P-1's approved connector and grounding lead. The shop's revised power worksheet hasn't been forwarded to the base planning cell yet, so it wouldn't have shown up in their records. But I personally verified this with the supervisor — P-1 needs to go to the battery shop.
transcript.speaker: A4

I've confirmed that the refrigerated storage area will receive a continuous-temperature shipment requiring P-3's 24-hour runtime capability. The receiving manifest hasn't been linked to the power-allocation request yet, so it wouldn't have appeared in the planning records, but I personally verified this requirement. That means P-3 needs to go to the refrigerated storage area.
